description: Wazu connects ChatGPT to the user's authorized personal and cohort memory. It can inspect the active Wazu scope, list permitted cohorts, retrieve recent or topic-matched evidence, hydrate complete items and document passages, explore related evidence through Hive Map, retrieve bounded media references, and save user-authorized summaries, text, or media into an explicit cohort.

defaultPrompt: Show my Wazu account context and available cohorts, then help me choose the right one.
